summary: Iteration 6 covers Stage Kit bundles, reviews (verified buyer, photo upload) and Galaxy V image regeneration. Backend: 15/15 pytest passing (products list=24 with 9 bundles; kit-lightning-v-strings-green includes lightning-v/groovamp-12/strings-green, full=$632.99, price=$538.04=full*0.85; kit-galaxy-v-strings-purple 200; POST /api/payments/checkout for kit-storm-v-strings-blue returns Stripe checkout_url; GET /api/shop/products/galaxy-v/reviews returns seeded review with photo_url /api/files/<id> and file returns 200 image/*; can-review: galaxy-v already_reviewed=true,can_review=false, storm-v purchased+can_review=true, groovwah purchased=false; POST reviews forbidden on groovwah 403; storm-v first POST 200 verified=true author 'GroovLabz Admin', duplicate 409; unauth POST 401; rating=6 422; POST /api/uploads/review-photo PNG 200 with id+url, .txt 400; GET /api/files/nonexistent 404). Frontend: /shop stage-kit-builder default lightning-v+strings-blue price $538.04/$632.99 matches API; clicking kit-guitar-galaxy-v -> $453.04; switching to strings-green keeps $453.04; kit-includes has 3 imgs; no bundle product-card-kit-* in grid; kit-add-to-cart opens cart drawer with 'Stage Kit' item. Home: home-stage-kit renders compact builder with kit-add-to-cart. /shop/kit-galaxy-v-strings-purple: product-detail-page + product-includes with 3 linked items + 'You save' text; product-related contains no bundle items. Reviews UI: logged-out /shop/storm-v shows reviews-section+review-login-prompt; after admin login, /shop/storm-v shows review-form, clicked rating-star-4, filled title/body, uploaded PNG via review-photo-input, review-photo-preview appeared, submit succeeded and review-already appeared with 4-star review rendered; review photo loads (naturalWidth=1 for 1x1 PNG, complete=true). /shop/groovwah shows review-not-purchased. /shop/galaxy-v shows review-already and 1 review with review-photo naturalWidth=200 (seeded jpeg). /shop/galaxy-v main image + product-thumb-1 load. Regression /apps, /apps/groovsesh, /instruments, /account all load.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing separator/whitespace between average number and review count — rendered text is e.g. '41 review' (should be '4 · 1 review' or '4 / 5 · 1 review'). Data assertion still contains '4' and '1 review', but visually reads as '41 review'. In JSX, the two adjacent <span> elements have no spacing so avg '4' abuts '1 review'.

action_items: Reviews.jsx: add explicit whitespace/separator between average and review count in [data-testid="reviews-summary"] (e.g., insert a  ·  between the average and count spans).
Consider splitting server.py (945 lines) into routers/{auth,shop,payments,reviews,uploads,account}.py — flagged in prior iteration and still growing.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend _build_kits correctly rounds price = full*0.85 to 2dp (verified kit-lightning-v-strings-green 632.99 -> 538.04).
Bundles excluded from /shop grid via filter (kind!=bundle); shop grid confirmed to render 0 kit-* product cards.
can-review endpoint correctly handles bundle purchases: buying kit-storm-v-strings-blue grants review rights on the constituent products (storm-v, groovamp-12, strings-blue) — verified.
Upload endpoint properly validates content type (400 on .txt) and writes to Emergent Object Storage; GET /api/files/{id} serves 200 with correct content-type; 404 for nonexistent id.
Duplicate review returns 409 (one per user/product) as spec'd; unauthenticated POST returns 401.
ProductDetail hides product-related bundle items and shows product-includes with 3 clickable child products + 'You save' text — verified visually and via DOM.
Reviews.jsx: minor JSX whitespace issue between average and count spans yields 'N1 review' rendering — cosmetic but visible.
server.py at 945 lines exceeds the 700-line guideline; recommend modularization.
seed_data_creation: Backend test posted 1 storm-v review during test_post_review_storm_v_then_duplicate; module autouse fixture and manual db.reviews.deleteMany({product_id:'storm-v'}) cleaned it. Frontend test also posted a storm-v review via UI (with 1x1 PNG upload) then deleted after. Storm-v collection is currently empty. Upload test wrote a small PNG blob to Emergent Object Storage (not cleaned — no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest -o addopts= backend/tests/test_iteration6.py. Storm-v reviews collection was cleaned at end of run; the seeded galaxy-v review remains. Emergent Object Storage is functional; uploaded review photos persist. Only known nit: Reviews.jsx reviews-summary lacks whitespace/separator between average number and 'N review(s)' — displays as '41 review' instead of '4 · 1 review'.
